programmes.d: The Cybermen are released from their silos and on the march.
The Doctor realizes the freighter is now a huge bomb, with one passenger still aboard....
The Master lures the Doctor.
Someone controls the Plasmatons.
A citadel contains Seraphim power.
The Doctor tries to outwit the Master.
During a clandestine meeting on Gallifrey, the Doctor is chosen to be a part of a terrible act; the Doctor and Nyssa trace something odd to Amsterdam.
Commander Maxil doesn't believe the Doctor is innocent; he thinks that the easiest way to stop the evil from being reborn on Gallifrey would be to kill him before the bonding can occur.
President Borusa thinks the creature has been defeated; within the Matrix, the Doctor unmasks Omega and realizes the threat is far from over.
Omega has been reborn in Amsterdam, but as a walking anti-matter bomb; the Doctor pursues him through the city.
Caught in a warp ellipse, the TARDIS is drawn to a huge spacecraft.
At Brendon School, the Doctor enlists the help of the Brigadier.
Mawdryn and his eternal mutants are awake and reveal the truth.
The Doctor's ethics are challenged and the two Brigadiers finally meet.
Turlough's attempt to destroy the TARDIS causes the ship to attach itself to a nearby space liner.
The ship's passengers are discovered to be space lepers being transported to Terminus for radiation therapy.
Nyssa contracts the dreaded space leprosy.
The Doctor enlists the aid of the Garm in averting the Second Big Bang.
The Tardis materializes on what appears to be an Edwardian racing yacht.
Turlough tries to commit suicide to escape the influence of the Black Guardian.
The Doctor discovers that the captain of the pirate ship is actually a concentrated beam of mental energy.
The Doctor manages to eject Wrack and pilot her vessel to victory.
At a medieval joust, the TARDIS appears.
The Master and the Doctor fight for control over Kamelion's mind.
(1/4) Seabase 4 is on alert as a strange craft approaches.
(2/4) The Silurians and Sea Devils send the Myrka in as a spearhead to an invasion.
(3/4) Vorshak's crew are cut down one by one by Sauvix's Sea Devil Warriors.
(4/4) The Doctor is despondent that no one wants to find another way to avoid so much death.
(1/2) In Little Hodcombe, the townspeople are causing a dormant entity, the Malus, to re-awaken.
(2/2) Each of the TARDIS crew witnesses a terrifying apparition from the past.
(1/4) On Frontios, the TARDIS has been destroyed.
(2/4) The Doctor faces the malevolent Tractators while revolution brews in the colony.
(3/4) Turlough's race memories of the Frontios threaten to overwhelm him.

(4/4) The Doctor has to find a way to break the Tractators' hold over Frontios.
Davros is held captive aboard a prison in space.
The Daleks have constructed android duplicates of the Doctor.
The battle at the prison station continues.
The Dalek agents on Earth take extreme measures to protect the time corridor.
Davros is held captive aboard a prison in space.
(2/4) Kamelion has taken the TARDIS to Sarn and is trying to locate his master.
(3/4) Timanov demands sacrifices to appease his god, Logar.
(4/4) The Doctor is forced to take drastic measures against Kamelion and the Master.
Gun-runners are on Androzani Minor, supplying the rebellious android-builder Sharaz Jek.
Salateen tells Peri and the Doctor they are dying from spectrox tomaemia.
Jek believes Peri will fall in love with him and the Doctor is caught by the gunrunners.
Morgus is ruined, and Jek goes on a murderous rampage.
The mysterious Professor Edgeworth has kidnapped twin human child genii.
On Jaconda, Mestor's cruel domination over the planet's population continues.
Mestor claims that all he wants is for the Sylvest twins to help him repopulate.
Mestor's true plan is revealed.
